name: Jiangxi Yuean Advanced Materials Co.,Ltd.
summary: Jiangxi Yuean Advanced Materials Co.,Ltd. primarily manufactures sophisticated metal powders and various membrane materials. Its comprehensive activities span the research, development, production, and distribution of a wide array of specialized products. These include crucial components such as carbonyl iron powder, magnetic material powder, atomized alloy powder, metal injection molding (MIM) feed, carbon nanotubes, advanced 3D printing alloy powder, and microwave absorbing materials. This enterprise was established in 2004 and has its headquarters situated in Ganzhou, China.
